dragon_store.title: Dragon Store
dragon_store.blurb: Watch Dragon Store. Paste a product page to watch that one product, or a category to watch everything in it; each scheduled run pulls the latest into your catalog.

watches.heading: What you watch
watches.empty: Nothing watched yet. Paste a product page or a category URL above.
watches.duplicate: You are already watching this URL.
watches.scraping: Reading it from the site — this can take a couple of minutes.
watches.queued: Waiting for its turn: {position} ahead of it.
watches.queued_next: Waiting for its turn — next up.
watches.cancelled: Cancelled. Nothing was added to your catalog.
watches.add_in_progress: One URL of yours is still being resolved. Wait for it to finish.
watches.invalid_url: That is not a Dragon Store product or category URL.
watches.busy: This one is being read right now. Try again when it finishes.
watches.include_ammaccati_hint: Separate listings, cheaper because the box is damaged. Applies from the next read.
watches.outcome_counts: {included} products went into your catalog, {excluded} dented listings were left out.
watches.outcome_cancelled: Stopped before it finished, so nothing was added. The input is still in your list — the next scheduled run will read it.
